description: The accounting and finance that information systems professionals must understand to build and audit business software: double-entry bookkeeping, financial statements and their analysis, costing and budgeting, investment appraisal, accounting information systems, payroll and tax basics, and the controls that prevent and detect fraud. Every transaction is posted in a simulated ledger in the browser, traced through to the statements, and then implemented as data structures and controls in a small accounting system.
modelledOn: Wood and Sangster, Frank Wood's Business Accounting
Romney and Steinbart, Accounting Information Systems
IFRS Foundation, IFRS for SMEs Accounting Standard
outcomes: Record business transactions by double-entry bookkeeping through journals, ledgers and a trial balance, including period-end adjustments.
Prepare and interpret an income statement, statement of financial position and statement of cash flows, and analyse them with ratios.
Calculate product and service costs, prepare budgets and analyse variances to support management decisions.
Appraise IT and business investments using payback, accounting rate of return, net present value and internal rate of return.
Design the data model, transaction cycles and internal controls of an accounting information system.
Calculate payroll and basic tax obligations and identify control weaknesses that allow fraud.

units.title: Accounting and the business
topics: Why accounting matters to IS professionals; financial versus management accounting
Users of accounting information; the accounting equation: assets, liabilities and equity
Accounting concepts: accruals, going concern, consistency, prudence and materiality
The regulatory framework: IFRS, IFRS for SMEs and the Institute of Chartered Accountants, Ghana
Forms of business: sole traders, partnerships, companies, cooperatives and susu groups

units.title: Double-entry bookkeeping
topics: Debits and credits; the chart of accounts and account types
Books of prime entry: sales, purchases, cash book and general journal; posting to the ledger
Balancing accounts and the trial balance; errors the trial balance does and does not reveal
Period-end adjustments: accruals, prepayments, depreciation, inventory and bad debts
Bank reconciliation, including mobile money wallet and agent float accounts
Bookkeeping for a market trader in Kumasi from sales notebook to ledger

units.title: Financial statements
topics: The income statement: revenue recognition, cost of sales, gross and net profit
The statement of financial position: current and non-current assets and liabilities; equity
The statement of cash flows by the direct and indirect methods; profit versus cash
Ratio analysis: profitability, liquidity, efficiency and gearing ratios; limitations of ratios
Reading the published annual report of a listed company on the Ghana Stock Exchange

units.title: Costing
topics: Cost classification: direct and indirect, fixed and variable, product and period costs
Absorption costing and overhead allocation; activity-based costing
Marginal costing, contribution and cost-volume-profit analysis; break-even charts
Relevant costing for decisions: make or buy, pricing and limiting factors
Costing a bag of processed shea butter for a women's cooperative

units.title: Budgeting and performance
topics: The budgeting process: sales, production, cash and master budgets
Fixed and flexible budgets; variance analysis for materials, labour and overheads
Cash flow forecasting for small businesses and seasonal trades
Budgeting for an IT department: capital and operating expenditure; total cost of ownership

units.title: Investment appraisal
topics: The time value of money: compounding, discounting and annuities
Payback and accounting rate of return
Net present value and internal rate of return; conflicts between them; profitability index
Inflation, high interest rates, risk and sensitivity analysis in investment decisions
Sources of finance: equity, loans, leases, microfinance and mobile lending
Appraising a solar power and server investment for a rural clinic

units.title: Accounting information systems
topics: Transaction processing cycles: revenue, expenditure, production, payroll and financing
Data modelling for accounting: the REA model and relational design of ledgers and journals
Implementing double entry in software: balanced transactions, immutability, reversal entries and rounding
Documentation: data flow diagrams, flowcharts and business process diagrams for AIS
Accounting packages, ERP finance modules and cloud accounting for SMEs; e-invoicing
Integrating mobile money payments and bank feeds

units.title: Payroll and tax basics
topics: Payroll calculation: gross pay, allowances, overtime and net pay
Statutory deductions in Ghana: PAYE income tax bands and SSNIT pension tiers
Value added tax and related levies; withholding tax; filing with the Ghana Revenue Authority
Payroll systems, payslips and posting payroll to the general ledger
Corporate tax principles and tax compliance for small businesses

units.title: Financial controls and fraud
topics: Internal control frameworks: the COSO components of control
Segregation of duties, authorisation, reconciliation and physical controls; application controls in software
The fraud triangle; common frauds: ghost employees, fictitious suppliers, skimming and lapping
Audit trails, continuous auditing, Benford's law and data analytics for fraud detection
Capstone: building and auditing a small double-entry accounting system for a susu group

schedule.title: Accounting, the equation and the business
schedule.exercise: Short problem set: classify 20 items as assets, liabilities, equity, income or expenses and restate each transaction in the accounting equation; then write a one-page note on which accounting concept (accruals, prudence, materiality) a given case breaks.

tasks.title: Classify 15 items from a Kumasi provision shop as assets, liabilities or equity and confirm the accounting equation balances after each of five transactions
Advise three entrepreneurs (a sole trader, a partnership and a susu group) on the best form of business, citing liability, tax and regulation evidence in the case file
Review a draft set of accounts that ignores accruals and materiality, select the evidence of each breach and justify the correction on a scored rubric

schedule.title: Debits, credits and the trial balance
schedule.exercise: Post a month of 25 transactions from a small trader into journals and ledger accounts by hand, then balance each account and extract a trial balance.

tasks.title: Build a chart of accounts table of 20 accounts with types and normal balances, then query it to list all asset accounts that normally carry a debit balance
Record 15 sales, purchases and cash transactions in a journal table and write SQL posting each entry to ledger accounts, then check total debits equal total credits
Find and correct five planted errors (omission, reversal, compensating, commission, one-sided) in a ledger database using a trial balance query, and say which errors the trial balance misses

schedule.title: Period-end adjustments and reconciliation
schedule.exercise: Prepare adjusting entries for a trader's year end (accrued rent, prepaid insurance, depreciation, closing stock, bad debts) and reconcile a mobile money wallet to the ledger.

tasks.title: Post year-end adjustments for accrued wages, prepaid rent and straight-line depreciation of one asset, then query the adjusted trial balance to confirm it still balances
Reconcile a mobile money agent float account against the ledger using a transaction table, listing each unmatched item and its cause in a reconciliation statement
Convert a market trader's sales notebook of 60 lines into journals and ledger, then adjust for stock and bad debts and produce a trial balance that agrees

schedule.title: Financial statements and cash flow
schedule.exercise: From a given adjusted trial balance, draw up an income statement, a statement of financial position and a cash flow statement, and explain in a paragraph why profit differs from cash.

tasks.title: Write SQL over a trial balance table to produce an income statement showing revenue, cost of sales, gross profit and net profit for a small shop
Query an adjusted trial balance to produce a classified statement of financial position and verify that assets equal liabilities plus equity to the pesewa
Explain why a profitable bakery runs out of cash by tracing the indirect cash flow reconciliation, then choose financing actions that fix it and score against a rubric

schedule.title: Ratio analysis and annual reports
schedule.exercise: Calculate ten ratios for two years of a listed company's accounts, comment on trends against a sector benchmark, and list three limitations of your conclusions.

tasks.title: Compute gross margin, current ratio and gearing for two years from a financial statements table using SQL and state whether each ratio improved
Build a ratio query comparing three competing retailers across profitability, liquidity and efficiency ratios, and rank them with a written justification of the ranking
Read an extract of a listed company's annual report, select the evidence behind a lender's decision to extend credit, and justify the choice against the rubric

schedule.title: Costing and break-even
schedule.exercise: Cost a product three ways (absorption, activity-based, marginal), draw its break-even chart and decide on a special order using relevant costs only.

tasks.title: Classify 20 cost lines of a small factory as direct, indirect, fixed or variable using a cost table and compute total fixed and variable cost
Compute contribution per unit and the break-even point for a bakery from a cost table, then test the margin of safety if sales fall 15 percent
Cost a bag of shea butter for a women's cooperative, decide whether to accept a bulk export order at a lower price and justify using relevant costs

schedule.title: Budgets and variances
schedule.exercise: Prepare a quarterly cash budget for a seasonal trader, then explain the variances between a flexible budget and actual results for materials, labour and overheads.

tasks.title: Build a sales, production and purchases budget table for four quarters and check that opening and closing inventory figures reconcile
Write queries comparing a flexible budget with actual figures to calculate materials, labour and overhead variances and flag the three largest adverse variances
Prepare an IT department budget with capital and operating items, compare three-year total cost of ownership of two server options and defend the recommendation

schedule.title: Time value of money and project appraisal
schedule.exercise: Appraise three mutually exclusive projects by payback, ARR and NPV; explain where the methods disagree and which you would recommend.

tasks.title: Use the maths lab to compute the present value of an annuity of GHS 5,000 for six years at 18 percent and check it against the formula
Compute NPV, IRR and profitability index for a minibus purchase over five years and plot the NPV profile to find the discount rate where it crosses zero
Rank two projects with conflicting NPV and IRR results, plot both NPV profiles to find the crossover rate and explain which project to choose under capital rationing

schedule.title: Risk, finance and the rural clinic investment
schedule.exercise: Prepare a short investment memo for a rural clinic's solar and server installation, with sensitivity analysis on inflation and interest rate, and a recommendation on how to finance it.

tasks.title: Recalculate an investment's NPV at inflation rates of 8, 15 and 25 percent and tabulate how the decision changes
Compare a bank loan, an equipment lease and a microfinance loan for a small business, choosing from the evidence provided and scoring against a finance rubric
Appraise a solar and server investment for a rural clinic under three scenarios, decide whether to proceed and defend the funding mix in front of a review board

schedule.title: Transaction cycles and double entry in software
schedule.exercise: Design a relational schema for ledgers and journals using the REA model, and write the SQL for a transaction that must post balanced debits and credits.

tasks.title: Draw a diagram of the revenue cycle from customer order to cash receipt, labelling each document and the ledger accounts it updates
Design and create an REA-based schema with sales events, customers, items and cash receipts, then load ten sample transactions and query a customer statement
Implement a posting transaction that refuses unbalanced entries, add reversal entries instead of deletes, and prove with tests that rounding never leaves a one-pesewa difference

schedule.title: Accounting documentation and integrations
schedule.exercise: Document an existing small-business invoicing process with a data flow diagram and a BPMN model, and write a half-page note on integrating mobile money payment notifications.

tasks.title: Draw a level 1 data flow diagram for a shop that takes orders, issues invoices and records payments, labelling every data store and external entity
Model an e-invoicing process between a supplier and the revenue authority as a BPMN diagram with exception paths for rejected invoices and tax errors
Match 40 mobile money payment notifications to open invoices with SQL, handle duplicates and partial payments, and post the receipts without breaking the ledger balance

schedule.title: Payroll, PAYE and VAT
schedule.exercise: Compute payroll for five employees with allowances and overtime, apply PAYE bands and SSNIT contributions, and prepare the journal entry for the payroll.

tasks.title: Calculate gross pay, overtime and net pay for six employees from an attendance table using SQL, and verify the total against a hand calculation
Apply PAYE income tax bands and the employee and employer SSNIT contributions to a payroll table, then reconcile total deductions to the amount payable to the authorities
Generate payslips and the payroll journal for a ten-person firm, post it to the general ledger and find the planted rounding error that breaks the trial balance

schedule.title: Controls, fraud and the susu capstone
schedule.exercise: Build a small double-entry system for a susu group with contributions, payouts and loans, then audit it for control weaknesses and write up your findings.

tasks.title: Review a small firm's cash handling procedure, identify which segregation of duties and authorisation controls are missing and choose the three most urgent fixes
Use a Benford's law first-digit query to screen 500 supplier invoices, flag the suspicious payee and the likely duplicate invoices, and summarise your evidence
Build and audit a double-entry ledger for a susu group with contributions, payouts and loans, then find a planted ghost-member fraud using audit-trail queries
